messages:
Anna (Partnerships): Hey folks — quick sync. We have 3 SI trainees in APAC asking for sandbox GPU access for the implementation labs next week. Can we confirm process?
Sam (Solutions Eng): Do they need dedicated instances or shared dev quota?
Anna (Partnerships): Shared dev quota should be fine for the labs, but they want to run a small finetune and a couple of throughput tests. So maybe a burst quota + larger ephemeral storage.
Michael (Training): For the bootcamp, we recommend 2 x A100-equivalent per trainee for the tunables session, but we can carve smaller slices if needed. How many seats?
Anna (Partnerships): 3 seats. Dates: Mon–Wed next week. Timezone preference APAC morning (UTC+8).
Priya (SI Ops): Filing access now. @DevOpsBot please create three sandbox groups, tag with si-bootcamp-1767, set quota cpu=8,gpu=2,storage=500GB,ttl=72h
DevOpsBot: Request received. Creating resources...
DevOpsBot: Resources created: group si-bootcamp-1767-a, si-bootcamp-1767-b, si-bootcamp-1767-c. Access links: https://internal.redwood/sandbox/si-bootcamp-1767-a (shared)
Lina (Marketplace): Quick note — if they use Marketplace images, they need Marketplace-approved AMIs. @Sam do we already have that AMI in ap-southeast-1?
Sam (Solutions Eng): Yes we have redwood-lab-2025-v3 in ap-southeast-1. Sharing runbook snippets for onboarding:
Sam (Solutions Eng): ```
# quick start for SIs
1) Request sandbox group via ops ticket
2) Accept invite link
3) Pull docker image: docker pull registry.redwood/redwood-lab:2025-v3
4) Start training: ./run_lab.sh --dataset sample --gpus 2
```
Michael (Training): Thx. Can we also provision pre-filled eval prompts and the lab notebook link? Saves time.
Priya (SI Ops): Adding the lab notebook to each group now. Notebook URL: https://notebooks.redwood/shared/si-bootcamp-1767/notebook.ipynb
Anna (Partnerships): Also planning a short certification check at the end — 30m practical test + short survey. Michael, want to own the check?
Michael (Training): I can run the practical check. I'll draft the checklist today and share in this thread.
Lina (Marketplace): Heads up — partner marketing wants to announce the cohort on the 2nd week of the month. We should avoid public mention until the SI signs the co-marketing NDA. @Anna can you confirm status?
Anna (Partnerships): We have 2 NDAs pending. I'll follow up with legal and update here by EOD. :+1:
Sam (Solutions Eng): One more ops ask — can we enable prefix caching for the lab instances to speed up repeated evals? Low risk and helps throughput.
Priya (SI Ops): Enabled prefix/KV caching for those groups. Monitoring set to verbose for the first 24h.
Michael (Training): Draft checklist posted: https://docs.redwood/internal/si-onboard/checklist-1767 (private). Feedback welcome.
Anna (Partnerships): Great work team. I'll ping the SIs with the access links and the checklist once legal confirms the NDA.
Priya (SI Ops): Closing the ops ticket, leaving it open for 48h in case of issues. Ticket: OPS-5821
Sam (Solutions Eng): I'll be on standby during the sessions. LMK if you want a pre-lab dry run.
Anna (Partnerships): Let's do a 30m dry run Friday 09:00 UTC+8. Who's in?
Michael (Training): In.
Priya (SI Ops): In.
Lina (Marketplace): In.
Sam (Solutions Eng): In.
Anna (Partnerships): Cool, calendar invite sent. Thanks everyone :rocket:
